sources.title: Firestone and the Warlord

gale-ruff.note: Confirmed in the ProPublica article: a plantation 'across 220 square miles', 'more than 8 million Hevea brasilienses', 'about 40 percent of the U.S. market for latex, and 10 percent of the world market', and, at the US ambassador's visit on 8 October 1992, 'More than 6,500 Liberians were back at work tapping rubber trees'.
